$meta.name: MEC-AI Design Tokens
$meta.warning: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH. Do not hand-edit generated tokens.dart / tokens.ts — edit this file and run `node packages/tokens/generate.mjs`.

risk_3band_deuteranopia.mitigation: MANDATORY redundant channels: band word + distinct icon + arc length. Color is never load-bearing alone. See docs/design.md §4.

series_blue_orange.note: safe to encode by color alone

validation.rule: If any surface or palette hex changes here, re-run the validator before shipping.

moderate.label: Moderate
moderate.note: Sub-3:1 on light surface. This is why the app is dark-first.

unknown.label: Incomplete profile
unknown.note: Rendered as a dashed neutral ring. Never show a colored band from partial input.

alarm.note: Acute SOS/alarm state. NOT a risk band — distinguished by motion + siren icon, not hue.

series.$note: Systolic and diastolic are two bounds of one quantity, so they take two tones of the one data hue rather than two hues — which also keeps the product palette to blue, green, red and white. Both tones are lifted from sequential.blue, so no new value enters the system. Green and red stay reserved for clinical status and are never a series.

threshold.$note: Two distinct jobs. chartReference is presentational — the hairlines and bands drawn on trend charts (docs/design.md §8). alert is clinical — the cut-points that decide an AcuteFlag's severity. Both generate into Dart and Python so an alert fires identically on device and server; a client-side copy that drifts from the server means two different answers to 'is this dangerous'.

alert.$note: Alerts must fire without a network. An SpO2 of 88% is an emergency whether or not the phone has signal, so these constants live on both sides and the evaluation runs locally.

temperature.$note: Body temperature only, from a contact sensor. Ambient air temperature never evaluates against these.

bloodPressure.$note: ACC/AHA staging. A stage fires when EITHER systolic or diastolic reaches the cut-point.

plausible.$note: Physiological-plausibility bounds, not clinical limits. A reading outside these is a sensor fault and is rejected rather than displayed.

heroFigure.note: Exactly one per view. Proportional figures only.

axisTick.note: The ONLY place tabular-nums is correct.

radius.$note: Material You shape scale. Supersedes the card-12/control-8 table in docs/design.md §3.5. Buttons, chips and FABs are pills (control); cards are lg; sheets and dialogs are xl; hero containers are hero.

standard.use: MD3 Emphasized. Default for every state, shape and position change.

decelerate.use: MD3 Emphasized Decelerate. Elements entering the screen.

accelerate.use: MD3 Emphasized Accelerate. Elements leaving the screen.

state.$rule: MD3 state layers are opacity overlays over the base colour, never a different hue. Reserved status colours (risk, alarm) keep their hue and take the same overlay.

elevation.$rule: Elevation is a hairline ring + tonal surface step (docs/design.md §3.5). These two shadows are for genuinely floating surfaces ONLY — never on a card at rest.

motion.$rule: All ambient/looping motion MUST stop under prefers-reduced-motion. Numbers snap to final value.

$rules: No dual-axis charts, ever. Four vitals = four charts.
Legend for >=2 series; none for single-series (title names it).
Text never wears the series color.
Every chart has a table-view twin.
On refetch hold previous render at reduced opacity; never flash a skeleton.
